verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'observability' as a topic covered in production hosting guidance and hooks/streaming provide raw events for tool calls and messages, but there's no dedicated tracing/observability UI documented (e.g., no trace viewer, no integration with an eval/observability platform). Community hands-on reports directly contradict any claim of built-in observability, describing the default harness as having '0 observability' and failing to display full tool-call/session details in its UI. missing for 10: a dedicated observability/tracing UI or integration, documented trace export (OpenTelemetry/etc.), and evidence resolving the community complaints about poor tool-call visibility.
